source.surface: Viewing differences modal, per-file accordion with the first file expanded against an empty prior snapshot
source.attribution: Screen curated by Mobbin (https://mobbin.com). Inspected remotely through the Mobbin MCP under accessMode 'remote-mcp'. No image was downloaded, cached, embedded, or stored anywhere in this repository; every value below is our own reading of the rendered screen.

evidenceTier.rationale: Mobbin is a curated gallery of captured screens. It is not a live observation we made of a running product, and no audience outcome is attached, so it cannot be silver/M2 or gold/M3. Treat these facts as evidence that a shipped product once looked this way, not as evidence that it worked.

decisionColour.acceptControl: no accept, apply, or revert control is present on this surface
decisionColour.acceptControlTreatment: not applicable — the modal only reads out what an agent already changed; the only exit is a close glyph
decisionColour.undecidedContainerTreatment: green tint marks added lines only; nothing on the surface is awaiting a decision
decisionColour.verdict: An after-the-fact change report rather than a pre-commitment review. Recorded deliberately as the contrasting case: when an agent's edits are shown only after they are applied, there is no decision colour to get wrong, and no decision either.
